redFirst.basis: regression mode, expectRedFirst false: the task adds a repo-wide guard test, no production code changed

outcome.technical: Added tests/denylist.test.mjs (node:test, zero deps). d1 lists files via execFileSync git ls-files -z at repo root, exempts docs/design.md and binaries (NUL byte), skips non-regular/deleted paths, reads .private/anonymise-denylist.txt at runtime (skips # and blank lines), case-insensitive match, fails with '<file>: term #<index>' only, and t.skip with a 'denylist not checked' message when the list is absent. d2 is a synthetic self-check of the scanner (case-insensitivity, binary/exempt skip, comment skip, no term in output). First run hit EISDIR on a tracked non-file path; fixed with a statSync isFile guard. Ran node --test tests/denylist.test.mjs: 2/2 pass, exit 0; full node --test: 50 tests, 50 pass, 0 fail, 0 skipped. No term was read into output or inlined.
outcome.descriptive: Repo-wide denylist guard now covers every tracked file, not only tests/fixtures, without ever printing a term.

testsAdded: d1 repo-wide denylist scan over git ls-files with visible skip when the list is absent
d2 scanner self-check on synthetic data
